summary: Created mcp-server/src/utils/workspace-versions.ts with WorkspaceVersions type and captureWorkspaceVersions() function.
Reads mcpServer from mcp-server/package.json (JSON parse), personas from personas/package.json (JSON parse), and orchestrator from orchestrator/pyproject.toml (regex /^version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/m).
Path resolution uses join(__dirname, '..', '..') for serverDir and join(serverDir, '..') for workspaceRoot — identical offsets from both src/utils/ (dev) and dist/utils/ (compiled).
All reads use readFileSync; throws on missing files (ENOENT) and on unparseable toml. No external dependencies.
Verified at runtime via tsx: returns { mcpServer: '1.24.0', personas: '3.15.1', orchestrator: '0.16.0' }.
Type-check passes (tsc --noEmit: no output). Full test suite: 1809/1809 tests pass.

comments.note: workspace-versions.ts computes serverDir and workspaceRoot inline — these constants are also computed in src/utils/ledger-root.ts. If workspace-versions.ts were ever extended or if the root derivation logic changed, there would be two places to update. A shared internal constant (e.g., exported from ledger-root.ts) would eliminate the duplication, but that would introduce a code dependency. Left as-is because it matches the parallel-module intent stated in the plan and the existing server-version.ts follows the same inline pattern.

summary: All four acceptance criteria verified. captureWorkspaceVersions() returns { mcpServer: '1.24.0', personas: '3.15.1', orchestrator: '0.16.0' } at runtime. Path offsets are correct for both src/utils/ and dist/utils/ locations. ENOENT propagates naturally from readFileSync; malformed TOML triggers an explicit throw. comments.note: The TOML version regex /^version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/m requires the version key at the start of a line with no leading whitespace. This is the standard pyproject.toml format (PEP 518/621) and matches the real file at line 3. An indented version key (e.g., inside a nested section) would silently fail and throw the parse error. Not a defect given the file format, but worth noting if pyproject.toml structure ever changes.

No dedicated unit test file exists for workspace-versions.ts. The function was verified via runtime tsx execution rather than Vitest. A test file at tests/utils/workspace-versions.test.ts would improve long-term confidence and cover the throw paths with mocked fs.

summary: workspace-versions.ts passes code review. Implementation is clean, idiomatic, and consistent with the existing server-version.ts pattern. All four ACs are confirmed met via QA pipeline. No blocking issues found. No Fix-Forward edits required.

The three 'as string' casts are all valid: for JSON parse paths, they make intent explicit (any → string); for the TOML regex path, noUncheckedIndexedAccess:true makes match[1] type as string|undefined so the cast is necessary for type safety.

Module-level constants (serverDir, workspaceRoot, path constants) are evaluated once at load time — efficient and consistent with server-version.ts. The documented code duplication with ledger-root.ts is an accepted trade-off per the implementation plan.
Two QA-flagged low-priority items echoed as improvement comments. One documentation-forward item raised for api-surface.md.

comments.note: TOML regex /^version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/m is section-unaware — it matches the first occurrence of 'version = ...' at any line start in the file. In the current orchestrator/pyproject.toml this lands on the [project] section version (line 3) before any other version keys. If a dependency pin like 'version = ">=1.0"' were ever placed above [project], the regex would match the wrong value. Not a defect today but fragile. Future-proofing option: anchor the search with a [project] header match first.
